title: They Grumbled
text: And there in the desert the whole congregation of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron.

title: Pots of Meat
text: There we sat by pots of meat and ate our fill of bread, but you have brought us into this desert to starve this whole assembly to death!

title: Bread from Heaven
text: Behold, I will rain down bread from heaven for you.

title: A Test
text: In this way I will test whether or not they will follow My instructions.

title: The Glory of the LORD
text: … and there in a cloud the glory of the LORD appeared.

title: Quail
text: That evening quail came and covered the camp …

title: A Layer of Dew
text: … and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.

title: Flakes like Frost
text: … there were thin flakes on the desert floor, as fine as frost on the ground.

title: What Is It?
text: … they asked one another, “What is it?” For they did not know what it was.

title: No Excess, No Shortfall
text: When they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.

title: None Until Morning
text: No one may keep any of it until morning.

title: It Became Infested
text: … some people left part of it until morning, and it became infested with maggots and began to smell.

title: It Melted Away
text: Every morning each one gathered as much as was needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.

title: Twice as Much
text: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much food—two omers per person …

title: Two Omers
text: … and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this to Moses.

title: A Holy Sabbath
text: Tomorrow is to be a day of complete rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD.

title: It Did Not Spoil
text: … and it did not smell or contain any maggots.

title: Nothing in the Field
text: Yet on the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, but they did not find anything.

title: The People Rested
text: So the people rested on the seventh day.

title: How Long Will You Refuse?
text: How long will you refuse to keep My commandments and instructions?

title: Manna
text: Now the house of Israel called the bread manna.

title: A Jar of Manna
text: Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna. Then place it before the LORD to be preserved for the generations to come.

title: Forty Years
text: The Israelites ate manna forty years …

title: The Bread of Life
text: I am the bread of life. | Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.

title: An Omer for Each
text: You may take an omer for each person in your tent.

title: What Is It?
text: When the Israelites saw it, they asked one another, “What is it?”

title: Wafers Made with Honey
text: It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.
